arStrings.szText: "What do you see in my spirit?"
Belial attempted to wear your mind and body as a cloak, as he has done to so many unfortunate mortals. But in your case, something turned him aside. He mentioned Lilith...

Such a thing is your affair. But Belial's essence remains mingled with yours. You've a connection with him, and with the powers he and his minions wield. By absorbing more of that essence, you can gain more power.
Destroying as many of these Apparitions as you can will slow Belial's influence, perhaps even gain advantages that can be used to defeat him. I must engage in more research to find any weakness.
Come outside. There's more you need to see.
